Corollary
[Boundary curvature structural alternatives] 1. ch14:14.7\group ch14-boundary-gradient Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0357 Under the solution hypotheses of Theorem 14.6, assume (14.43), (14.51), and either (14.53) or (14.54). Then \begin{equation} |Du|\leq C\qquad \text{on }\partial \Omega , \tag {14.55} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,M,\bar\mu ,\Omega ,K,|\varphi |_{2;\Omega })$.
Proof

\sketch Reduce the structural alternatives to (14.50), then apply Theorem 14.6.

□

For \begin{equation} \mathfrak Mu=nH(x,u)(1+|Du|^2)^{3/2}, \tag {14.56} \end{equation} with $H\in C^1(\overline\Omega \times \mathbb R)$ and $D_zH\geq 0$, the curvature conditions become the following result.
